 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Anup Jairam Bhambhani
ORDER % 27.03.2026 CRL.M.A. 9186/2026 (exemption) Exemption granted, subject to just exceptions.
Let requisite compliances be made within 01 week.
The application stands disposed-of.

By way of the present petition filed under section 528 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita 2023, the petitioner seeks quashing of case FIR No.0433/2022 dated 30.08.2022 registered under sections 420/406/34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 at P.S.: Seelampur, Delhi, on consent.
There were 06 persons arrayed as accused in the FIR; however the petition is filed only by one of them.
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 02/04/2026 at 20:37:58
Learned proxy counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner seeks adjournment, submitting that respondent No.2 is not available today.
Re -notify on 22nd July 2026.
The parties are directed to remain present in court on the next date of hearing.
ANUP JAIRAM BHAMBHANI, J MARCH 27, 2026/ak
